title: Network Device Must Use SSH Version 2 for Interactive Management
description: The network device must use SSHv2 and disable legacy protocols (SSHv1, Telnet) to provide strong interactive session encryption.
rationale: DoD policy strictly requires FIPS-approved encrypted transport for all in-band device management.

title: Network Device Must Not Employ Insecure Telnet Service
description: Telnet is unencrypted and transmits credentials in cleartext. Network devices must disable the Telnet server daemon.
rationale: Cleartext credentials can be intercepted by adversaries with packet capture capabilities.

title: Network Device Must Disable Insecure HTTP Management Service
description: The HTTP server daemon exposes administrative sessions to sniffing and must be disabled across all interfaces.
rationale: Unencrypted web management violates DoD transport encryption mandates.

title: Network Device Must Enforce Password Minimum Length of 14 Characters
description: Administrative passwords must have a minimum length requirement of at least 14 characters.
rationale: Mitigates dictionary attacks against device local emergency administrator accounts.

title: Network Device Must Terminate Inactive Management Sessions <= 10 Minutes
description: The network device must be configured to terminate interactive management sessions after 10 minutes (600s) of inactivity.
rationale: Prevents unauthorized individuals from hijacking unattended terminal sessions.

title: Network Device Must Display Standard DoD Advisory Notice Banner
description: The network device must display the approved DoD legal notice banner prior to granting access to interactive users.
rationale: Legal warning banners are legally required before access to DoD information systems.

title: Network Device Must Transmit Audit Logs to Centralized Syslog Server
description: All security events, authentication attempts, and configuration changes must be forwarded off-device to a central syslog repository.
rationale: Guarantees forensic integrity of log events independent of the monitored network device.

title: Network Device Must Synchronize Internal Clock with Authenticated NTP
description: The network device must synchronize its internal system clock using authenticated Network Time Protocol (NTP).
rationale: Ensures time synchronization for cross-system correlation of audit trails.

title: Network Device Must Enforce SNMPv3 Only with Auth and Priv
description: Legacy SNMPv1/v2c must be removed and only SNMPv3 using cryptographic authentication and privacy encryption permitted.
rationale: Unencrypted SNMP exposes network topology and device health data.

title: Network Device Must Enforce Centralized AAA Authentication
description: Authentication for interactive administrative access must use centralized AAA servers (RADIUS/TACACS+).
rationale: Centralized AAA enables prompt account revocation and granular privilege controls.

title: Network Device Must Not Transmit ICMP Redirect Messages
description: The network device must not send ICMP redirect messages on any interfaces.
rationale: ICMP redirects can allow malicious nodes to modify routing behavior on end systems.

title: Network Device Must Disable IP Directed Broadcasts
description: The network device must disable IP directed broadcasts on all operational interfaces.
rationale: Directed broadcasts allow networks to be used as amplification tools in denial of service attacks.

title: Network Device Must Disable Proxy ARP on External Interfaces
description: The network device must have Proxy ARP disabled on all connected interfaces.
rationale: Proxy ARP introduces layer 2 confusion and facilitates man-in-the-middle exploits.

title: Network Device Must Implement Unicast RPF Ingress Filtering
description: The network device must implement Unicast Reverse Path Forwarding (uRPF) to drop spoofed IP source addresses.
rationale: Prevents entry of spoofed network packets into the enclave.

title: Network Device Must Record Detailed Timestamps on Log Events
description: System logging messages must include millisecond timestamp precision and explicit UTC time indicators.
rationale: Ensures forensic logs across systems align accurately during cyber incident analysis.

title: Network Device Must Allocate Adequate Logging Buffer Storage
description: The network device must maintain a local logging buffer configured with sufficient memory to preserve event history.
rationale: Provides a secondary log store when network connectivity to centralized syslog is disrupted.

title: Network Device Must Authenticate NTP Packets with MD5/SHA
description: The network device must authenticate with NTP time servers using cryptographic keys.
rationale: Prevents unauthorized manipulation of the device clock.

title: Network Device Must Implement SNMPv3 authPriv with AES
description: SNMP management access must enforce SNMPv3 with authPriv level utilizing AES encryption.
rationale: Guarantees confidentiality and authenticity of management interactions.

title: Network Device Must Implement Control Plane Policing (CoPP)
description: The network device must implement control plane protection to prevent resource exhaustion from packet floods.
rationale: Shields the central CPU from denial of service attacks.

title: Network Device Must Authenticate All BGP Peer Sessions
description: The network device must authenticate all BGP peering sessions using MD5 or SHA cryptographic hashes.
rationale: Prevents malicious injection of rogue routing information.

title: Network Device Must Enforce AAA Accounting for Privileged Commands
description: The network device must generate accounting records for all configuration and executive commands.
rationale: Provides non-repudiation and traceability of administrator actions.

title: Network Device Must Restrict SNMP Access via Access Control Lists
description: SNMP agent queries must be constrained using management access-lists.
rationale: Prevents unauthorized hosts from querying SNMP MIBs.

title: Network Device Must Disable Unauthenticated OSPF Adjacencies
description: OSPF routing areas must enforce cryptographic MD5 message-digest authentication.
rationale: Prevents rogue routers from poisoning OSPF link-state databases.

title: Network Device Must Restrict Layer-2 Discovery Protocols
description: CDP and LLDP must be disabled on all external and untrusted perimeter interfaces.
rationale: Prevents automated discovery of switch hardware and software versions.

title: Network Device Must Configure Secure Shell Session Rekey Limits
description: SSH connections must enforce periodic cryptographic session key regeneration.
rationale: Protects long-lived sessions from cryptanalytic attack.

title: Network Device Must Enforce BGP Peer Maximum Prefix Limits
description: BGP neighbor sessions must define maximum prefix thresholds to prevent route table exhaustion.
rationale: Prevents route table overflow from peer misconfiguration or attacks.
